Text: Walk into a room to join!
name: TextLabel

Text: 1. Pick a room and press Ready.
name: TextLabel

Text: 2. You get a random job, Bills, kids and debts.
name: TextLabel

Text: 3. Your turn: Payday, then pick a Small or Big Deal.
name: TextLabel

Text: 4. Buy Money Makers. They give Free Money.
name: TextLabel

Text: 5. GOAL: Free Money bigger than Bills = you ESCAPE!
name: TextLabel

Text: Free Money: you get it every month without work.
name: TextLabel

Text: Bills: you pay them every month.
name: TextLabel

Text: Money Makers: things that make Free Money.
name: TextLabel

Text: Debt: money you owe. Pay it, Bills go down.
name: TextLabel

Text: Money Left: the cash you have now.
name: TextLabel
